## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `dev` and its title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Design or convention changes have a new or updated ADR in `docs/ADR.md`, and DESIGN.md or CICD.md is updated to match
- [ ] Workflow changes pass `actionlint`, pin actions to a full commit SHA, and declare minimal `permissions`
- [ ] No secrets, and no unredacted org IDs, billing accounts, CIDR plans or emails
- [ ] New cloud resources (if any) carry the repo's resource tag (ADR-012)
